Chapter 6664: Not An Immortal

Chapter 6664: Not An Immortal

“You’re not getting to our lord!” A furious yet still pleasant voice resounded.

Another woman appeared; her beauty invoked admiration and praises. Her features must be the epitome of feminine beauty.

Alas, others couldn’t get a good look at her due to enveloping primordial dao.

“Buzz.” After her shout, the primordial dao turned into a primordial tree. Its incredible aura took over Life and Death Heaven.

More beauties appeared within the primordial dao. Their vitality and power became one with it. The leader was the first beauty with the primordial tree.

“Immortal Slayer Guard.” A primal ancestor murmured.

At first, this group only had one member - the alluring woman. Later on, she recruited more members to protect the lord.

The leader had a physique attuned to the primordial dao, hence her ability to use it. Thus, she was able to connect to the primordial tree.

Later on, Desolate Ancestor helped her with this special dao, strengthening the connection. The other members helped her maintain the connection with the tree. Therefore, she was just as crucial in the lord’s defense as Guardian Blade of Life and Death.

“Bam!” A primordial wall appeared and stopped Bao Pu’s advance.

“What?!” Spectators were shocked.

“How can this be?” Some couldn’t believe their eyes. Bao Pu crushed all the barriers thus far as if they were worthless.

“How can a non-overlord stop an immortal?” This broke logic itself.

Although Bao Pu was a broken immortal, he still could kill overlords.

“This is miraculous.” A primal ancestor murmured.

“Trained by Desolate Ancestor herself, a physique so close to the primordial.” Godstallion said.

With a connection to the tree, the guard leader could borrow the power of the primordial. This was the thing stopping Bao Pu.

“Incredible.” Bao Pu observed the wall: “You are the only one who can use this type of power outside of Desolate Ancestor. Unfortunately, you cannot stop me since you are not an immortal.”

He summoned a silver drill the size of a fist. Immortal flames coiled around the tip.

“Boom!” Its rotation was fast enough to pull time and space, forming a chaotic maelstrom.

“Damn!” Heaven-slayers and primal ancestors bellowed after feeling a piercing pain.

The drill began hitting the primordial wall, causing devastating sparks. The first move didn’t break through completely but the rotational force never stopped.

“Rumble!” The explosions and shockwaves caused many to vomit blood.

Cracks appeared on the wall, prompting the guardians to burn their true blood.

“It’s useless.” Bao Pu pushed the drill, increasing the speed several times.

“Boom!” The wall collapsed, unable to handle both the drill and Bao Pu’s immortal power.

The guards vomited blood and were sent flying despite being protected by the primordial tree. Bao Pu advanced again, entering the deepest area with no one else to stop him.

“Your Majesty, excuse me.” He threw his drill in her direction, piercing through space and time.

“!!!” Everyone was horrified since she was occupied with the lightning bolts.

The drill appeared before her, ready to pierce her head.

In this crucial moment, she raised her hand and summoned Death Coffin. It stopped the drill but the bolts pierced through her for another set of grievous injuries.
